Download the file for your device:

| Device                    | File                         |
| ------------------------- | ---------------------------- |
| Android phone             | `MyLittleTown-…-android.apk` |
| Windows PC                | `MyLittleTown-…-win.exe`     |
| Mac (Apple chip or Intel) | `MyLittleTown-…-mac.dmg`     |

The iPhone version isn't on this page: it has to go through TestFlight or the App Store.

**Installing**

- **Android:** open the APK and allow installing from your browser or Files app when asked. This is a test build. It installs over the previous one, so your town is kept.
- **Windows:** run the installer. If "Windows protected your PC" appears, click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
- **Mac:** open the .dmg and drag My Little Town into Applications. The first time, macOS blocks it: go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**. Or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/My Little Town.app"` in Terminal.

These builds aren't signed with paid certificates yet, which is why the warnings appear. Log in with your account to bring your town to a new device.
